'''Emily Cramer''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is currently affiliated with KMR Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Cramer is an actress who joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}. Several of her roles were previously done by [[Kate Bristol]], who left the series at the same time as Cramer's arrival.
